column1: # hand triage of the non-SAME groups (file, line, value, kind) no rule of rc_triage.py covers, or whose rule result needs a
# note; `check` is evaluated by rc_triage.py over the pin, the twin, cgif's twin and the checked files, and must hold.

column7: PAGE_OK and has('A/AD1g.v', 'apply Z_mod_mult || (change 6217728 with (1482 * 4096); apply Z_mod_mult)') and IMG[1] - IMG[0] == 6217728 == 1518 * 4096 != 1482 * 4096
column8: 4096 = the page size (p_align 0x1000 in both builds). The identity it sits in is false: 6217728 = IMG_TOP - IMG_LO = 1518 * 4096, not 1482 * 4096; it is the right branch of `apply Z_mod_mult || (..)`, which no goal reaches (a reached branch would fail the build). cgif's own line holds the same 1482 beside its extent 6205440 = 1515 * 4096, so 1482 is no cgif quantity either

column7: has('A/AD2a.v', 'Theorem tfib_open_toolong : (4096 <= length p)%nat') and has('A/AD2a.v', 'firstn 4096 p')
column8: 4096 = the path-length limit of the open model (tfib_open_toolong: a path of 4096 bytes or more is refused); here the length argument of rdn_firstn over firstn 4096 p

column7: has('A/AFjq.v', 'constr:(Uv) 4096 190 0x327d0') and has('A/AFjq.v', 's_runS HR tfibtbl_rtA tfibtbl_rtA_ok 0x99b74') and ab1w['tfib_A_memset_libc'] == 0x99b74 and any('Allocator8Allocate' in n for n in func_at(0x327d0))
column8: the malloc fill of ASan: memset of min(size, 4096) bytes with the fill byte 190 (0xbe), the defaults of the sanitizer flags max_malloc_fill_size / malloc_fill_byte; the call returns to 0x327d0 inside __asan::Allocator::Allocate and runs memset at 0x99b74 = tfib_A_memset_libc; not an image quantity

column7: has('A/AFjq.v', '(SLit 4096) Uv 4096 190 0x327d0') and any('Allocator8Allocate' in n for n in func_at(0x327d0))
column8: the same malloc fill (both numerals of the line: the fill length SLit 4096 and the length argument): max_malloc_fill_size 4096 with the fill byte 190 at the call that returns to 0x327d0 in __asan::Allocator::Allocate
